id.description: A UUID string identifying this signal report.

reason.description: Optional one-line explanation of why these reports are the same issue. Recorded on each source's 'duplicate of' link and on the note left on the survivor. Capped at 500 characters.

source_report_ids.description: Ids of the duplicate reports to fold into this one (1–10). Each must be a live report in this project: a resolved, archived or deleted report is rejected with 409, as is the survivor's own id. Duplicates in the list are de-duplicated. The whole merge applies or none of it does.
